name: xenorecomp-web
description: Xenon Recompiler for the web: recompiles Xbox 360 (Xenon PPC) binaries to WebAssembly in the browser, runs them in-page, and exports a project zip.

scripts.test: npm run test:recomp && npm run test:elf && npm run test:web && npm run test:hle && npm run test:gpu
scripts.test:gpu: node --test core/tests/test_gpu_pm4.mjs core/tests/test_gpu_webgpu.mjs core/tests/test_gpu_ring.mjs core/tests/test_vertex_fetch.mjs core/tests/test_gpu_vertex_binding.mjs core/tests/test_gpu_mmio.mjs core/tests/test_gpu_buffers.mjs core/tests/test_wgsl_translate.mjs core/tests/test_gpu_translated_draw.mjs core/tests/test_gpu_primitive_reset.mjs core/tests/test_render_state.mjs
